verdict.rationale: Expensify's travel page documents in-platform booking of flights, hotels, cars and rail as part of a corporate travel management offering, which covers the booking half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows travel policy being enforced at booking time. missing for 10: evidence of travel policy rules applied or enforced during booking (e.g., out-of-policy blocking or approval at booking), details of the booking flow, independent or hands-on corroboration of the travel product.
